responsibility: This header declares the quiet-mode printing wrappers for the mc front end. It exports the fixed-arity qprintf family that mirrors mcPrintf output but conditionally suppresses nonessential messages when the compiler is running in quiet mode.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the declaration-only counterpart to GmcQuiet.cc, exporting the qprintf wrapper family without the quiet-mode check and forwarding logic.
